meta.title: Put a line on hold and release it
gaps: Hold the selected PR line with the remark "Waiting for spec" and verify the hold icon and that it cannot be purchased
Release the held line without a remark and verify the refusal message "Please fill the remarks to continue!"
Release the held line with a remark and verify that it is open again
